name: ChoralRoot
intro: An Orchid-style chord instrument: hold a chord type with the left hand on the lowest seven keys, press a root from C4 up with the right, and ChoralRoot builds, voices and names the chord. Most buttons have new jobs (SEL is KEY, ENV is BASS, ARP is PERF, LFO is LOCK).

rows.what: Back to the main screen; there: the next view.
View menu: Chord, Keyboard, Notes, Geek Out, Scope.
Options: SELECT picks the entry, KNOB 1 its value.
Roots an octave down (OCT+ up); in a layer: closes it.
Alone, any key from C4 up plays one single note.
D major: the chord type held first, then the root.
D minor (black key 1 = DIM: diminished).
Both small keys under one finger: SUS (Dsus).
D7: F3-B3 add 6, 7, maj7, 9 to the type; they stack.
LOCK: chord keys stay on after release; tap again: off.
Voicing: moves the chord's notes up or down by octaves.
Key Mode: a lone root plays its scale chord (C major).
Set the key to D; OCT- closes (hold MIN too: minor).
Strum / arp on or off; hold ARP to pick the mode.
Next or previous chord sound of the same engine.
Change engine: FM6, FM TONE, VA, CZ-1, P5, WHEEL, GRAIN.
Bass on / off: a bass note under every chord.
The bass sound (first step: off).
Bass register, in octaves.
BASS layer: Chords Only, Unison, Single Notes, Solo.
Sound editor for the chord sound; EDIT again leaves.
Tempo, 20-300 BPM.
Arm the looper: the first chord starts, REC again ends.
Play / stop the loop (it records chords, not audio).
Undo the last recorded layer.
PLAY menu: PRESETS slot 1-10, ALGORITHM record mode.
Metronome on / off.
All effects on / off.
FX layer: Sends first; SELECT steps to reverb, chorus, delay, drive.
Chord send into the effect last picked in the FX layer.
Save menu: Overwrite or Save as new; OCT+ saves.
Save everything: settings, LOCK, bass, FX and the loop.
Both for 1 second: back to the last save.
PANIC: every note off, LOCK and LATCH cleared.
Update mode (three flashes) for reinstalling.
5 seconds while running: update mode too.

keys.label: Chord type: DIM, MIN, MAJ (MIN+MAJ = SUS)

tips: Chord keys must be down before the root goes down; the chord name stays on screen.
Any held button (FX, SEL, ENV, ARP, LFO, PLAY) opens its layer and it stays open; OCT- or HOME closes it.
SUS = G#3 and A#3 together: lay one finger across both small black keys.
Loops and settings survive power-off only after holding SAVE (the global save).
Classic Orchid layout (SUS on C#4, 9 on C4, LOCK on B3): Options > Chord Keys.
LATCH (keeps the sound ringing, e.g. an arpeggio): hold GLO, then tap LFO.
Try it without the FM-1 first: quixotic7.github.io/ChoralRootFM1/emu/
checked: v0.25.1 archive (thefirmwarehub.com/src/choralroot-0.25.1.tar.gz), firmware/src/cr_ui.c lines 29-41: BT_KEY = B_SCL (printed SEL), PERF = ARP, BASS = ENV, LATCH/LOCK = LFO, OPT = GLO, METRO = SEQ, LOOP = PLAY.

cr_ui.c 57-62: CU_MOD_OF_KEY_FM1 = {6, DIM, m7, MIN, M7, MAJ, 9, -, -} for keys F3..C#4; CU_ROOT0_FM1 = 7 (C4); CU_FN_KEYS 1 on FM-1; cr_settings.c 118: new/updated units default to CRS_LAYOUT_FM1. SUS pair: cu_tk_resolve / cu_tk_decide (~4290-4440).

cr_ui.c cu_tap (3019): SEL Key Mode toggle, ARP perf toggle, FX fx toggle, ENV bass on/off, LFO cu_lock_tap on FM-1 layout, GLO opens Options (PLAY menu / KEY layer: their keys), EDIT editor, SAVE save dialog, SEQ loop editor, PLAY loop play/stop, REC cu_rec.

cr_ui.c cu_btn_press (4846): OCT- + OCT+ -> cu_panic; GLO held + SEQ metronome, + LFO LATCH (FM-1), + REC next record mode; ENV held + EDIT/SAVE bass editor/save; SAVE held alone -> cu_gsave (settings commit + loop write); GLO+SAVE held -> revert timer.

cr_ui.c cu_knob (5084): SELECT tempo 20-300; PRESETS chord pool; ALGORITHM off + bass pool; KNOB 1 voicing; KNOB 2 bass register; KNOB 3 perf first param; KNOB 4 chord send into CU_FX[cs.fx_sel]; OPT + PRESETS/ALGORITHM engine picker (cu_epk_step); OPT + KNOB 1 split point.

cr_ui.c cu_home_tap: closes layers/options/pages, else next view (CU_VIEW: Chord, Keyboard, Notes, Geek Out, Scope, Geek Out 2); HOME held 600 ms view menu. cu_oct_tap: octave -2..+2 on the view, closes layers. cu_opened: REC held = LP_UNDO.
cr_engine.c crx_build_base + CR_KEYMAP: Key Mode lone root -> scale chord (major: I maj, ii min, ... vii dim); CU_BASSMODE: Chords Only, Unison Bass, Bass Single Notes, Solo.

cr_backup.c cr_update_poll: OCT- + OCT+ + HOME held 5000 ms -> update mode; stub/stub.c stub_main: OCT- at power-on -> loader, three blinks. main.c 211: OCT- + OCT+ at power-on = calibration (not on the sheet).
unsure: Exact default tempo and which factory sound loads first not checked in code (notes from an earlier session say FM6 TINE EP).
Save menu default choice: Overwrite for a user/edited sound, Save as new (then naming) for a factory one (cu_save_open); row simplified to 'OCT+ saves'.
FX layer page list (Sends, Reverb 1/2, Chorus, Delay 1/2, Drive, Filter) taken from the manual; only the SELECT-moves-picker logic was read in code.
Engine list order (FM6, FM TONE, VA, CZ-1, P5, WHEEL, GRAIN) from README/manual, not from the engine table.
